Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. Tender security must be submited from any e-GP Schedule bank in favour of Chairman KDA, Khulna.
2.The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in Installation /
Supply works of at least 1(One) contract(s) of the minimum value of similar nature, complexity and method/construction technology
successfully completed within the last 5(five) years, with a value of at least Tk.25.00 Lac .Years counting back ward from the date
of publication of IFT in e-Gp portal.
The Contractor must have the following specific experience in the above Mentioned and other contract :
(i) Must have experience of Toll Machine Installation.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk. 52.00 Lac in the last 5 (Five) years. Payment
certificates for contract in progress or completed under public sector during last 5 (five) years must be submitted along with the
tender in support of average annual construction turnover.
4. Liquid assets/ working capital/credit facilities Tk. 13.00 Lac.
5. The Tender Capacity is Tk. 37.00 Lac Supporting document must be submitted along with information as per enclosed form
(ongoing works/commitments)
6. The Tenderer must enclose up-to-date Trade license, Income Tax clearance certificate, VAT registration certificate.
